friendly_name: Slice F: the kind taxonomy and the mission-type schema
purpose_context: R18 is one of the last undecided cutover reads in epic #94, and core's scope migration moved the kind-taxonomy and mission-type schema rulings here. They change one model: which kinds exist and how a mission type's steps are authored. The charter's model is canonical, so old shapes are replaced outright and open-packs follows.
purpose_tldr: Serve the kind table as data (R18), retire mission_step_contract, make steps the single mission-type authoring surface, and type each relation's endpoint kinds.
